 Iñigo Pérez updates Villarreal injuries and warns of Espanyol’s unknowns ahead of La Cerámica test 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Iñigo Pérez is wary of Espanyol ’s reaction at La Cerámica, despite their crisis and recent cup exit, and wants Villarreal to turn home into a platform for belief and wins.
 El Periódico Mediterráneo reports that the Villarreal head coach expects uncertainty under Sergio García, noting the noise around the visitors demands extra alertness, although limited preparation time may restrict drastic changes.
 OneFootball Videos
 He stressed the priority is Villarreal’s own plan, keeping what has worked and correcting what has not, while anticipating a highly aggressive opponent motivated by responsibility after Manolo González’s departure.
 Pérez dismissed the demanding schedule and accumulated knocks as excuses, saying recent victories at Mestalla and in Manacor have lifted the mood and offered lessons to keep and areas to tidy up.
 He highlighted the high press as a clear identity, adding that Villarreal are either the best or second best for ball recoveries in the opposition half, and that the players have embraced it.
 The improvement he seeks is in the final third, with calmer decision-making to convert dominance into goals, citing the Elche match where early profligacy and later haste against a solid defence blunted their attack.
 On availability, Ilias Akhomach and Nathan Saliba are out injured, and he said the rest of the squad is available for tomorrow.
 Source: El Periódico Mediterráneo
